meta.title: About us – Swiss solar company from Grenchen
meta.description: DoubleA Solar Solutions is a Swiss solar company based in Grenchen SO – founded in 2025, active in Solothurn, Biel, Bern and across Switzerland. Solar technology, IT expertise and project coordination from a single source.

intro.title: A Swiss solar company with clear standards.
intro.text1: {legalName} was founded in Grenchen in {founded} and works from here across all of Switzerland. What defines us is the combination of solar technology, IT expertise and project coordination.
intro.text2: We are a young company and say so openly. In return, you get short lines of communication and a way of working built on documentation rather than promises.
